verdicts.reason: A: 'Spa Utopia' runs over the green dropper bottle on the left. The 'Weekly SPA items review' subtitle is set tiny, in a cramped two-line wrap, on top of busy leaf stems, so it can't be read at 320x50, and the original's brush-stroke backing is lost. B has the same problems and is a little worse: the headline sits on the glass dish, and the subtitle lands on the cream jar rim and leaves with even less contrast, so it is essentially unreadable.
